categories.name: Training-free methods
categories.description: Methods that do not require model training, relying on retrieval or memory synchronization at inference time.

categories.name: Unified retrieval-reasoning
categories.description: Approaches that jointly model retrieval and reasoning through shared architecture or pre-training.

categories.name: Context-aware KG integration
categories.description: Methods that incorporate context-aware knowledge graphs to reduce token overhead and improve reasoning.

categories.name: Triple extraction
categories.description: Focus on extracting structured triples from unstructured text to construct or enrich knowledge graphs.

categories.name: Context-enriched triple training with adaptive repair and RL transfer
categories.description: Proposed approach that enriches training triples with local context subgraphs, employs an adaptive repair loop for fact correction, and applies reinforcement learning transfer from lower-hop to higher-hop QA.

idea_position: Context-enriched triple training with adaptive repair and RL transfer
common_assumptions: Triples can be reliably extracted from source passages.
Contextual information (e.g., local subgraphs, distilled KGs) improves multi-hop reasoning.
Unified modeling of retrieval and reasoning enhances performance.
Hybrid retrieval of KG triples and textual evidence improves QA recall and ranking.

repeated_limitations.description: Limitations not explicitly stated or discussed in the paper.
Performance limited by the quality of retrieved evidence or knowledge graph; errors in retrieval propagate and cannot be easily corrected.
Method evaluated on limited datasets or domains, raising questions about generalizability.

underexplored_combinations: Combining context-enriched triple training with adaptive repair loops for fact correction.
Integrating unified retrieval-reasoning frameworks with local context subgraph enrichment.
Applying reinforcement learning transfer from lower-hop to higher-hop QA in training-free methods.
Using adaptive repair to improve the quality of extracted triples from text.

contradictions.description: No direct contradictions found; differences lie in whether approaches rely on training the model (fine-tuning) versus inference-time mechanisms (retrieval, memory synchronization).
